Class ToolkitRunner.Builder

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.toolkit.app.ToolkitRunner.Builder
Enclosing class:
ToolkitRunner
public static final class ToolkitRunner.Builder extends Object
Builder for ToolkitRunner instances.

Provides a fluent API for configuring the toolkit application including bindings, style engine, and auto-registration of annotated action handlers.

    • app

      public ToolkitRunner.Builder app(Object app)
      Sets the application object containing @OnAction annotated methods.

      This object will be used for automatic action handler registration when withAutoBindingRegistration() is called.

      Parameters:
      app - the application object
      Returns:
      this builder

    • config

      public ToolkitRunner.Builder config(TuiConfig config)
      Sets the TUI configuration.

      Use this to configure terminal settings (raw mode, alternate screen, tick rate, mouse capture, etc.). All builder methods (including bindings(Bindings)) use last-write-wins semantics.

      Parameters:
      config - the configuration
      Returns:
      this builder

    • withAutoBindingRegistration

      public ToolkitRunner.Builder withAutoBindingRegistration()
      Enables automatic registration of action handlers.

      Discovers and registers handlers for methods annotated with @OnAction on the application object set via app(Object).

      this builder

    • faultTolerant

      public ToolkitRunner.Builder faultTolerant(boolean enabled)
      Enables or disables fault-tolerant rendering.

      When enabled, individual element render failures are caught and replaced with error placeholders, allowing the rest of the UI to continue rendering. When disabled (default), render exceptions propagate to the TuiRunner's error handler.

      Parameters:
      enabled - true to enable fault-tolerant rendering
      Returns:
      this builder

    • errorOutput

      public ToolkitRunner.Builder errorOutput(PrintStream errorOutput)
      Sets the output stream for error logging.

      Defaults to a null output stream that discards all output. In fault-tolerant mode, errors are displayed via placeholders rather than logged to avoid flooding the terminal.

      Parameters:
      errorOutput - the error output stream, or null to discard output
      Returns:
      this builder

    • postRenderProcessor

      public ToolkitRunner.Builder postRenderProcessor(ToolkitPostRenderProcessor processor)
      Adds a post-render processor.

      Post-render processors are called after each frame is rendered, allowing for effects, overlays, or other post-processing.

      Parameters:
      processor - the processor to add
      Returns:
      this builder
